name: pink-kitty-bedroom-scream
image_vibe: playful pink bedroom with suspense contrast

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic square phone photo with a playful pink bedroom and a harmless fictional suspense element.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with long dark hair, glasses, natural skin texture, soft pink makeup, and a calm relaxed gaze lies on her stomach on a bed, propped on her forearms and holding a vintage white handset phone.
prompt.composition_elements: Pink satin bedding with magazines and popcorn, gray cat-themed graphic tank and black lounge shorts, soft pink walls, retro posters, a partly open white door, and a distant fictional figure in a non-graphic ghost mask in the darker hallway.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even indoor ambient light on the subject, gentle pink room tones, darker hallway contrast, playful non-graphic suspense mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic iPhone-style photography, square 1:1, close low-angle phone framing, natural skin texture, soft unedited color, no harsh flash.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic square phone photo of an original approved adult woman with long dark hair and glasses lying on her stomach on a bed with pink satin sheets, calmly holding a vintage white telephone. She wears a gray cat-themed graphic tank and black lounge shorts. Magazines and popcorn rest on the bed; soft pink walls, retro posters, and a partly open white door frame a distant fictional figure in a simple non-graphic ghost mask in the dim hallway. Soft natural indoor lighting, playful bedroom storytelling, natural texture, 1:1.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, graphic gore, weapons, threatening attack, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, warped hands, unreadable text, watermark

assets.name: pink bedroom phone reference
assets.usage: Match the adult subject's reclining pose, pink bedding, phone, and doorway composition.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Keep identity, pose, outfit coverage, room palette, props, and suspense contrast consistent. Identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, and typography elements must be replaceable; replace recognizable character or brand graphics with approved alternatives when needed.

changes: Clarified the subject as an original approved adult model.
